overall: Four of the Committee's members violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating via email on the communications policy; two members and the chair's Select Board email were not violations, and intent was not found.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee chair emailed Select Board members about a personal interaction with a town employee, deliberating outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: As Chair Tool was the only member of the Committee included on this email chain, we find no deliberation by the Committee in this case, as a quorum of the Committee was not involved in the exchange.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that Committee members deliberated on the Committee's communications policy via an August 10-13 email chain without a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the emails of Committee Members Hassan, Siegars, and Lyon, as well as the initial email from Chair Tool, constituted improper deliberation because a quorum of the Committee discussed the Committee's communications policy, which is a matter of public business that should be reserved for an open meeting.

allegations.summary: Two Committee members were alleged to have taken part in the email chain on the communications policy; one did not respond and the other only warned against deliberating.
Complainant urged that the email violations were intentional under the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Board has not previously been warned that deliberation via email violates the Open Meeting Law. In addition, we find no specific evidence that the Committee acted with deliberate ignorance of the Law's requirements.

allegations.summary: The request for further review raised additional allegations beyond the original complaints; the AG declined to review them.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review any additional allegations made in the request for further review.

remedy: Direct the Select Board, within 30 days of receipt of the letter, to publicly release the August 10 through 13 email chain in which four Committee members deliberated via email.
If the Committee is reinstated, order its immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; no further relief ordered because the Committee disbanded.
remedy_passage: we direct the Select Board, within 30 days of receipt of this letter, to publicly release the August 10 through 13 email chain in which the four members of the Committee deliberated via email.
